rundown: Bears beat Tigers 104-55 at Foster Pavilion in Waco, TX. Bears led 60-19 at half-time and never looked back. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 99%).
Leading the way — Tigers: DJ Davis 9 pts; Blake Nettles 4 ast; Nikk Williams 6 reb. Bears: Brett Decker Jr. 35 pts; Isaac Williams IV 8 ast; Elijah Williams 7 reb.
Where Bears won it: they shot 58% to 42%, shot 44% from three to 21% and won the boards 39-22.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Bears closed as 33.5-point favorites and covered by 15.5; the total closed at 156.5 and they combined for 159, over by 2.5.

review.body:

Final: Tigers 55 – Bears 104. Right winner: it had Bears at 99%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Tigers came in with a 8% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (2-3, 68.4 scored and 83 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 186 and 187 games of evidence. Projected to score 63.5, they scored 55 (−8.5 points, 13% under); projected to allow 90.8, they allowed 104 (+13.2 points, 15% over).

Bears came in with a 10% above average attack and a 8% stingier than average defense (3-1, 89.5 scored and 63.5 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 179 and 178 games of evidence. Projected to score 90.8, they scored 104 (+13.2 points, 15% over); projected to allow 63.5, they allowed 55 (−8.5 points, 13% under).

The bigger miss was Bears' scoring (+13.2 points against projection).

Total: 159 against 154.3 projected (+4.7), about the 63rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.010 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +22.8 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 21.7 points), no bet.
